name: rockgame
description: The stone-skipping game. App shell plus the feature labs: rock-forge, rock-sift, babylon-water, stone-skipping-physics, sand-sim — each living in its own page.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n hub,sift,forge,sand,throw -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan "vite" "npm --prefix rock-sift run dev" "npm --prefix rock-forge run dev" "npm --prefix sand-sim run dev" "npm --prefix throw-lab run dev"
scripts.deploy: node tools/build-site.mjs && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name rockgame
scripts.test: node tools/store-test.mjs && node tools/loader-test.mjs && node tools/backend-contract-test.mjs && node tools/schema-check.mjs && node tools/pinned-cdn-check.mjs && node tools/workspace-check.mjs && node babylon-water/tools/page-syntax-check.mjs && node babylon-water/tools/ambient-sync-check.mjs && node babylon-water/tools/scheme-stability-check.mjs && node tools/water-coupling-check.mjs
